description: [Industrial B2A / Clearing] Initializes a 2-of-3 Swiss multi-signature escrow contract under Swiss Code of Obligations. Enforces strict cryptographic public key or institutional IBAN format validation.

buyer_pubkey.description: Cryptographic public key (e.g. 0x02a1b2...) or institutional IBAN account (minimum 10 alphanumeric characters). Dummy/freeform strings are strictly rejected.

seller_pubkey.description: Cryptographic public key (e.g. 0x03ff1e...) or institutional IBAN account (minimum 10 alphanumeric characters). Dummy/freeform strings are strictly rejected.

name: geo360_swiss_escrow_deposit
